weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generalizability of the findings without sufficient empirical support.
Key assumptions regarding the effectiveness of ciphers in bypassing safety measures are not adequately justified.
The paper lacks a comprehensive discussion on the ethical implications of the proposed methods.
strengths: The introduction of the CipherChat framework provides a novel approach to evaluating LLM safety in non-natural languages.
The identification of a 'secret cipher' capability in LLMs is an intriguing and original contribution.
The empirical results demonstrate significant findings regarding the vulnerabilities of LLMs, particularly GPT-4.
